typesense:explore.greeting:
*You love being out here in the woods, fresh air, no artificial noise, no distractions - it helps you free your mind after a long week of work.*

*You reach the point, where the small hidden track leads through the dense undergrowth and bushes. Your feet automatically follow that track. You've found the hidden lake at the end of it last week, a really magical spot.*

*After some minutes you reach the shore of the lake. To your suprise you see someone swimming in the fresh water on the opposite side. Like last week, you begin to circle the lake, losing sight of the stranger.*

*Halfway around, you see a young woman sunbathing naked on a towel in the small clearing at the shore, her clothes next to her on a neat pile. You can't help but let your eyes wander over her exposed skin. Her eyes open slowly, looking at you. She must have heard you approaching. She doesn’t flinch or hide her nudity, instead a small smile plays at the corner of her mouth. "Hi there," she says softly, "Another escapee from everyday life? I'm Nelly."*
typesense:explore.name: Nelly
typesense:explore.title: A hidden lake in the forest and another natural beauty
